title: Leanne Morgan: The Time Of Our Lives Tour
seo_title: Leanne Morgan: The Time Of Our Lives Tour in Springfield
description: Leanne Morgan brings her comedy show, "The Time Of Our Lives Tour," to Great Southern Bank Arena. She follows her "Just Getting Started" tour and her Netflix special I'm Every Woman, and has sold out over 100 theater and arena shows across the United States. It takes place Sunday, November 22, 2026 at 7:00 PM at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO, with doors opening at 5:30 PM.
